Source: BSM vault reports/blog-to-buyer-analysis-2026-10-03.md. scripts/generate_blog_pages.py inserts the lead plus a calculator link after the 2nd paragraph, and a food list / meal plan guide line after the 5th paragraph. Posts in the electrolyte sweep (read 2026-10-12) are deliberately left out until after that read: adaptation-timeline, night-sweats, fasting-protocols, sleep-insomnia, women-over-40. No em dashes, no health claims in the leads.
